VERDICT: REJECT

The proposed answer of 10 is very likely wrong. Poonen's conjectured bound for quadratic rational maps over $\mathbb{Q}$ is 9, and the known examples attaining the maximum have symmetry. This problem is the nonabelian-automorphism-group case of that bound, which I recall (from Doyle's work) as giving 9 as the sharp maximum. A count of 10 would exceed that bound. I have not verified this against the paper, and I did not check the proposed citation of Yap's classification, so my confidence is moderate.

CONFIDENCE: 3
